summary:
Reviewed migrate-kb-2's 4 commits (f897853, 38c6496, 225b787, c023c75), which match the implementer's result.
No change under features/. No test removed or weakened; the one allowance row (status step strips backticks, plan decision 4) holds.
All changed modules under 300 lines; tools check: vulture clean, no import contracts, ruff only house-style UP031 and lines that predate the diff.
Important observation: supersedes_of (scripts/migrate_ledger.py:73-83) now splits a qualifier that names a decision, e.g. '(in part; see decision/0004-c)', into a bogus target. The old code kept the whole qualifier, so this input regresses on r17. No scenario names it; reproduced by probe.
Minor/drop: the qualifier's whitespace is normalised; ruff style.
